posts.title: X-Men Reboot Has Christopher Abbott “Excited” to Play Professor X for Marvel Studios
posts.excerpt: Christopher Abbott can't wait to play Marvel's most famous telepath. All he needs now is a script. While officially confirmed to be playing Professor Charles Xavier in Marvel Studios' long-awaited X-Men reboot, Abbott has yet to see the screenplay from Beef creator Lee Sung Jin and The Bear co-creator Joanna Calo. Not altogether surprising, given that the film isn't slated to come out for another two years.
